baseline_models.focus_anchor: The isolated definite designation ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ and its root ر ح م.
baseline_models.mechanism: The tenderness branch makes the one-word opening recipient-facing: mercy moves toward vulnerability as compassion and beneficence rather than remaining an abstract property.

activation_trace.role: Tenderness and beneficence supply the affective impulse and its outward movement toward one shown mercy.

changed_reading.before: A divine title conventionally glossed as the Merciful.
changed_reading.after: An abundant, recipient-facing movement of tenderness and beneficence, not an inert attribute.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ر ح م root of ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ can activate the kinship branch without leaving the focus word.
baseline_models.mechanism: Kinship turns mercy into a connective obligation: it makes giver and recipient non-strangers whose bond calls for maintenance rather than a one-off favor.

activation_trace.role: The close-kin bond supplies durable relation and the duty not to sever it.

changed_reading.before: Mercy is a benefactor's optional kindness to another.
changed_reading.after: Al-Rahman names the maker and keeper of a bond in which the recipient is treated as connected, not alien.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ر ح م root of the focus name carries the womb branch.
baseline_models.mechanism: A womb is an enclosing, nourishing environment in which dependent life is formed. The name can therefore model mercy spatially and materially as a life-making surround.

activation_trace.role: The womb supplies enclosure, nourishment, dependence, and formation as a concrete mercy mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Mercy is primarily a feeling or favorable act.
changed_reading.after: Al-Rahman can name the containing ecology inside which fragile life becomes possible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus root inventory preserves a branch of womb pain, disease, or retained afterbirth after delivery.
baseline_models.mechanism: The rare branch prevents the maternal image from becoming frictionless: generation leaves pain and residue that require continued care. Mercy may include repair after emergence, not only shelter before it.

activation_trace.role: Post-delivery womb affliction supplies vulnerability, residue, and the need for aftercare.

changed_reading.after: Al-Rahman may also evoke care that stays with the wound and unfinished aftermath of bringing forth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence can be read as gestation: revelation is gathered and made knowable, its human recipient is brought into being, and interior meaning is delivered into signs. Mercy precedes the recipient and forms both the communicative world and the capacity to enter it.

activation_trace.role: The womb supplies the focus-anchored container and formation process.
The branch of a womb gathering a pregnancy makes the Quran's gathering function a gestational activator.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the movement from hidden content to apprehended knowledge.
Bringing creation into existence supplies formation of the receiving human.
Revealing meaning through speech or sign supplies the delivery of an interior into expression.

structural_cues: The isolated name is followed by three subjectless verbs whose implied actor is naturally carried forward from 55:1.
Teaching the Quran precedes creating the human, while teaching expression follows creation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, disclosure, creation, expression, and their order; I supply the arrow that treats the order as a gestational process. A live alternative is a non-causal ranking of gifts.

changed_reading.before: The name announces kindness toward an already existing recipient.
changed_reading.after: Al-Rahman names a mercy that first prepares meaning, then forms its recipient, then brings the recipient into articulate response.

context_deltas.mechanism: Calculation, balance, equitable measure, assigned placement, and germinating seed turn mercy into an enabling order. Limits are not opposed to tenderness; proportion and non-transgression are the infrastructure by which a shared habitat remains fruitful.

activation_trace.role: Beneficence anchors the ordered system as recipient-serving rather than merely mechanical.
Counting and calculation supply predictable celestial measure.
The just balance makes proportion a moral as well as cosmic regulator.
Equity supplies the social distribution rule that preserves the shared order.
Putting something in its lower or assigned place turns earth into deliberately situated support.
The seed that germinates supplies the life-result made possible by measured placement.

structural_cues: 55:5-12 moves from calculated luminaries to a raised sky, a placed balance, commands against excess, earth for creatures, and reproductive food.
The same balance vocabulary joins cosmic description to human imperatives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calculation, balance, equity, placement, and growth; I infer that proportion causally enables flourishing and that social measure mirrors cosmic measure. Alternatively, balance may be a judicial demand adjacent to, rather than a mechanism of, mercy.

changed_reading.before: Mercy relaxes constraint and gives generously.
changed_reading.after: Al-Rahman is also the giver of exact limits whose fairness and stability let many lives flourish together.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two expanses are released into encounter yet held against transgression; from them something valuable exits. The womb model becomes a selectively permeable boundary: mercy permits contact and production without allowing one side to erase the other.

activation_trace.role: The womb supplies a bounded interior that supports emergence.
Mixing and disturbance supply the risk generated when the two seas are released together.
The meeting of two opposed things supplies real contact rather than sealed isolation.
The middle interval between two things supplies the membrane-like zone.
Overstepping in aggression identifies the failure that the interval prevents.
Passage from an interior to its outside supplies the productive emergence of pearl and coral.

structural_cues: 55:19-22 gives meeting, a branchless lexical barrier, non-transgression, then emergence from the paired seas.
The dual forms preserve two participants throughout the mechanism.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies release, meeting, an interval, blocked aggression, and emergence; I infer that the boundary enables rather than merely precedes the valuable output. A live alternative is that the verses list separate wonders without a causal membrane model.

changed_reading.before: Womb-like mercy means complete insulation from difference.
changed_reading.after: Al-Rahman can be the boundary intelligence that allows encounter, restrains invasion, and lets a third good emerge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sheath, enclosed garden, inner lining, restraint, and tent repeat nested interiors. Mercy protects by regulating exposure: valuable life ripens within coverings and becomes available without first being made maximally visible.

activation_trace.role: The womb supplies the primary protected interior.
The plant sheath supplies a covering in which fruit is held before exposure.
A garden hidden by its trees supplies a flourishing enclosure rather than an empty wall.
The inside of a thing makes even the furnishings explicitly layered and inward.
Confinement to a bounded object supplies disciplined attention and guarded access.
Tent and dwelling supply a final inhabited layer of enclosure.

structural_cues: The packet repeatedly nests goods in sheaths, tree-covered gardens, textile interiors, bounded gazes, and tents.
The missing inventory for ط م ث is used only as a structural cue in the repeated statements of untouchedness; no branch identity is assigned to it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nested covers and guarded access; I infer that concealment preserves ripeness and relation. A live alternative is that these are independent images of luxury or privacy with no general protection mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Mercy is maximal exposure, disclosure, and unrestricted access.
changed_reading.after: Al-Rahman may protect life through selective opacity, staged access, and inhabited enclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The recurring dual question converts gifts into claims on recognition, and it continues across warning scenes. Mercy is therefore not indulgent exemption: it addresses, teaches the boundary, exposes denial, and preserves an order in which destructive excess has consequence.

activation_trace.role: Beneficence anchors the repeated address as concern for recipients rather than detached accusation.
Blessings supply the object repeatedly placed before the two addressees for acknowledgment.
Nurturing, repairing, and bringing to completion make the repeated speaker-recipient relation developmental.
Attributing a thing to falsehood turns nonrecognition into an active rupture of the offered relation.
Flame without smoke supplies the severe boundary consequence enclosed by the same refrain.
The help branch enters under explicit negation, marking a point where mutual rescue cannot cancel the consequence.

structural_cues: The same dual refrain follows creation, provision, cosmic boundaries, mortality, threat, judgment, and gardens.
The addressees are repeatedly required to answer rather than remain passive beneficiaries.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the refrain's unchanged form across benefit and warning; I infer that warning can serve mercy by making limits answerable. A live alternative is that the refrain marks lordly signs generally while the punishments themselves should not be called merciful.

changed_reading.before: Al-Rahman means that adverse consequence is suspended.
changed_reading.after: Al-Rahman can name a mercy that addresses denial and enforces life-preserving limits rather than erasing accountability.

context_deltas.mechanism: Early mercy teaches the outward sign of inward meaning; later, questioning falls away because persons are distinguishable by embodied marks and can be seized accordingly. This creates a severe legibility arc: expression is gift, but being made readable also supports responsibility.

activation_trace.role: Beneficence anchors communicative capacity as a mercy before its judicial consequences appear.
Meaning disclosed through speech or sign supplies voluntary articulation.
Questioning and request are explicitly negated, removing spoken inquiry at the judgment point.
Recognition by an effect or sign supplies immediate identification.
A visible mark that makes its bearer known supplies embodied evidence.
Being taken to account for wrongdoing turns recognition into consequence.

structural_cues: 55:4 gives taught expression; 55:39 removes questioning; 55:41 substitutes recognition by marks.
The arc moves from a learned sign system to an involuntary sign system.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies expression, absent questioning, recognition, marks, and taking; I infer one arc in which merciful communicability grounds answerability. A live alternative is that the early pedagogical and late judicial sign systems are unrelated.

changed_reading.after: Al-Rahman grants legibility itself: the power to express inward meaning and the condition of remaining readable to just consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creaturely forms end, the divine face remains, dependents keep asking, and each bounded interval contains a fresh affair. Mercy shifts from guaranteeing permanent objects to continuously attending, repairing, and re-answering finite life.

activation_trace.role: Beneficence supplies the caring orientation of the ongoing response.
Cessation after a period of remaining makes every creaturely provision finite.
Continuance supplies the stable source against which finite recipients change.
Request and need supply recurrent dependence from every realm.
A bounded duration supplies the rhythm in which care is freshly enacted.
The branch of repairing and perfecting work activates each affair as active maintenance.

structural_cues: 55:26-29 juxtaposes universal perishing, the remaining divine face, universal asking, and a fresh affair in every day.
The indefinite affair resists reducing care to one repeated product.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies finitude, remaining, requests, daily duration, and affairs; I infer the request-to-renewed-maintenance arrow. A live alternative is a contrast of creaturely dependence with sovereignty, without implying temporal replenishment.

changed_reading.before: Mercy is possession of durable favorable things.
changed_reading.after: Al-Rahman is the continuously available source whose care is renewed precisely because every created form is finite.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible human and hidden jinn are created differently yet repeatedly addressed as one dual audience and finally summoned as a collective. The kinship branch expands beyond bloodline: Al-Rahman creates a relation of shared reception and answerability across an ontological divide.

activation_trace.role: The kinship bond supplies the focus-anchored possibility of relation among otherwise unlike recipients.
The visible human contrasted with wildness and jinn supplies one side of the ontological pair.
Hidden beings supply the unlike counterpart addressed beside humanity.
A collective or kin-group image turns the two kinds into a summoned address-community.
Nurture and completion supply the shared relational source named by the dual 'your Lord.'

structural_cues: The refrain's dual pronouns recur before the explicit joint summons to humans and jinn in 55:33.
Clay-like material and fire distinguish origins while the address keeps pairing recipients.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distinct creatures, dual grammar, and a collective summons; I infer that shared address constitutes a mercy-bond between kinds. A live alternative is that the dual only coordinates two separate audiences without making them relationally akin.

changed_reading.before: The kinship resonance of ر ح م remains biological and intra-human.
changed_reading.after: Al-Rahman can establish a non-biological kinship of reception and accountability between visible and hidden creatures.

context_deltas.mechanism: A fitting posture before the Lord opens onto gardens, and excellent action is met by excellence. Mercy remains prior, yet its kinship-like relation invites participation and returns conduct in a transfigured form rather than treating recipients as inert consumers.

activation_trace.role: The kinship bond supplies a reciprocal relation without reducing mercy to a commercial exchange.
Fear as expectation of harm supplies the recipient's serious orientation toward the encounter.
Standing or abiding at a station supplies the relational scene before the Lord.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the return arrow.
Beautiful doing on both sides makes the returned good resemble and exceed the initiating human good.

structural_cues: Two gardens are assigned to whoever fears the standing of the Lord, and 55:60 explicitly folds excellence back onto excellence.
The refrain keeps the return inside gift-language rather than bare wage-language.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the conditional garden and mirrored excellence; I infer a participatory mercy mechanism in which response is fitted to posture and action. A live alternative is rhetorical celebration of reward without a broader reciprocity model.

changed_reading.before: Mercy is unilateral giving with no meaningful recipient response.
changed_reading.after: Al-Rahman sustains a relation in which received good can become good action and return as enlarged flourishing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing blessing returns explicitly to the Lord's name. Stable, growing good, nurturing completion, and generosity make the opening one-word name a frame whose contents are enacted across the surah, not merely a label placed before them.

activation_trace.role: Tender beneficence supplies the semantic program named at the opening.
A name as indication and elevation makes naming itself the closing object of attention.
Repair, nurture, and completion summarize the long enacted relation between Lord and recipients.
Honored generosity supplies the giving pole joined to the closing name.
Stable, growing good makes the name's effects durable and generative.

structural_cues: The surah begins with a single divine name and ends by blessing the name of the Lord.
ج ل ل at 55:78 is retained only as a branchless structural cue of majesty; no mapped root or branch is invented for it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the opening name, the closing name, growth, nurture, generosity, and branchless majesty; I infer that the whole intervening sequence performs the opening name. Alternatively, the endpoint may be a doxological closure rather than a deliberate semantic loop.

changed_reading.before: 55:1 is a heading-like label before the surah's actual predicates.
changed_reading.after: Al-Rahman is the generative frame enacted by every subsequent gift, limit, warning, ending, and renewal before the text returns to the blessed name.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the cited context forms do not lexically denote childbirth in their verses; activation comes from distant branches of birth, pregnancy, labor, and postpartum condition. It remains anchored in the focus root's explicit afterbirth-affliction branch and the packet's recurrent material images. Render only as an exploratory analogy in which Al-Rahman stays with generation's painful aftermath, never as a translation of the context words.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The B004 branch of ر ح م in ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ centers pain or disorder of the womb after delivery.

activation_trace.role: Post-delivery womb affliction anchors mercy in aftercare rather than idealized maternity.
The branch of laying down a pregnancy by giving birth activates earth's placement as a delivery image.
Conception and growth of a pregnancy supply a deliberately distant formation analogy for the raised constructions.
A laboring animal's cry supplies the bodily strain normally erased from paradisal repose.
A postpartum or newly delivered condition supplies the vulnerable state requiring rest and care.

changed_reading.before: Womb-mercy is only prenatal shelter and effortless production.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, Al-Rahman includes the labor, wound, residue, and continuing care by which emergence is actually completed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The menstrual and appointed-time branches of ق ر ء are form-distant from 'Quran' here, so this cannot bear a lexical claim. It remains worth carrying because the focus womb branch, counted luminaries, daily duration, and formally repeated refrain all converge on measured recurrence. Render as a temporal-pattern hypothesis: mercy may pulse through gathering, release, and return, not as an assertion that the verse means menstruation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The womb branch of the focus root allows reproductive time, not only reproductive space, to become an anchored question.

activation_trace.role: The womb supplies the bodily process whose protection is rhythmic as well as spatial.
The branch spanning menstrual flow and purity supplies alternating reproductive phases.
A time that arrives or is delayed supplies appointment and interval.
Counted celestial motion supplies an external clock for recurrence.
A duration of time supplies the repeating interval of renewed action.
Blessings supply the recurring content marked by the refrain's cadence.

changed_reading.before: Al-Rahman is a static, continuously uniform attribute.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the name may frame mercy as measured cycles of gathering, release, return, and fresh enactment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Calling a non-penetrable, flame-guarded cosmos womb-like is deliberately unsettling because womb normally connotes safety. It remains anchored in the focus's containing-vessel branch and in explicit packet branches of penetration, authority, and flame. Render only as a bounded-order analogy: hospitality has a membrane and conditions; do not equate punishment itself with tenderness.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus womb branch makes enclosure and its boundary a live property of mercy.

activation_trace.role: The womb supplies an inhabited enclosure whose membrane is constitutive, not accidental.
Passing cleanly through to the other side supplies the attempted breach of the cosmic enclosure.
Compelling warrant or proof supplies the exceptional condition under which passage is imaginable.
Flame without smoke supplies the violently guarded edge of the boundary.

changed_reading.before: Merciful enclosure means unrestricted safe movement and easy exit.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, Al-Rahman may frame a habitable but non-optional order whose protective boundary cannot be crossed without fitting authority.

strongest_changes: The opening name became a gestational pedagogy that prepares meaning, forms a recipient, and delivers expression.
Mercy became calibrated habitat: balance and non-transgression are enabling conditions of flourishing.
The womb branch became a selective boundary that allows meeting and valuable emergence without collapse of difference.
Universal perishing revised mercy from permanent goods to continuously renewed care.
The recurring dual challenge made mercy an accountable address rather than exemption from consequence.
The final blessing of the Lord's name made the opening name a frame enacted by the whole surah.
summary.what_was_special: A one-word focus sustained several coexisting mechanisms instead of collapsing to a soft synonym: affective beneficence, kinship, womb ecology, calibrated order, selective concealment, communicative legibility, reciprocal relation, and severe boundary. The packet repeatedly made opposites productive: disclosure coexists with shelter, encounter with non-transgression, finitude with renewed care, and gift with accountability.
remaining_uncertainties: The childbirth, menstrual, and guarded-womb outliers depend on deliberately distant branches and should remain analogical rather than lexical.
The repeated refrain may place warnings within mercy's pedagogy, or may only place both gifts and warnings under lordship without calling the warnings merciful.
Protective opacity and judicial legibility may be sequential complements, or genuinely competing readings of what mercy does.
The shared dual address may constitute trans-kind kinship, or may simply coordinate two separate audiences.
